bd.mcpUrlLabel: This BunDeck is the MCP server
bd.mcpHintSelf: Point your MCP client (Claude Code, etc.) at this URL with a token to control EVERYTHING: profiles, pages, buttons (icon, texts, actions and order), plugins, settings and logs.
bd.mcpSub: Your BunDeck as an MCP server: full control with per-token permissions.
bd.mcpAdminWarning: A token with all permissions can change EVERYTHING: profiles, pages, buttons, actions, plugins and settings. Grant only what is needed and revoke tokens you don't use.
bd.mcpNoTokens: No tokens yet. Create one for your MCP client.
bd.mcpTokenOnce: Copy it now: the secret won't be shown again.
bd.aiNeedToken: Manage your tokens in Settings → MCP: create one with the permissions you need and point your MCP client at this server.
bd.aiProposal: Your MCP client can already control everything: profiles, pages, buttons (icon, texts, actions), plugins, settings and logs. Create a token in Settings → MCP and use it from Claude Code.
bd.mcpHint: Connect an MCP server and the AI can see its tools to build your plugin.

bd.aiPlaceholder: Describe what you want your plugin to do…

bd.remoteSub: Two ways to connect: link another BunDeck or enter from a browser. Each has its own section.
bd.remotePairSub: Connect two computers that both run BunDeck (e.g. press a key here and switch the OBS scene on your streaming PC). Commands travel end-to-end encrypted and the server cannot read them.
bd.remotePairNeedBoth: Both computers need BunDeck installed. To enter from a phone without BunDeck, use the section below.
bd.remoteE2eNote: End-to-end encrypted (NaCl box, X25519). TLS is not E2E: the relay only sees metadata, never keys or actions. The private key never leaves this machine; shell and arbitrary HTTP stay blocked.
bd.remoteDisabled: Relay disabled on this machine. Local QR pairing still works.
bd.remotePairHint: A 6-digit code (10 min) plus this device's key fingerprint. The other BunDeck types the code and verifies the fingerprint.
bd.remoteRotateHint: Generates a new key pair. Unlinks every device: they will have to pair again.
bd.remoteQrHint: Show this QR on the other BunDeck to pair it without typing codes.
bd.remoteQrWarn: It expires soon. Don't share it outside your devices or show it fullscreen.
bd.remoteQrUpdate: Your daemon doesn't generate QRs yet (missing GET /api/v1/remote/qr). Update the daemon to use this section.
bd.remoteScanHint: From this computer, scan the QR shown by the other BunDeck to pair.
bd.remoteScanNoCam: No camera access (no camera or permission denied). You can paste the QR content below.
bd.remoteScanBad: That content is not a valid pairing QR.
bd.remoteScanVersion: Unsupported QR (version other than v1). Update the app.
bd.remoteScanFpBad: The QR fingerprint has an invalid format.
bd.remoteRelayMismatch: The QR carries a different relay than this device. If the local relay has no URL, set RELAY_URL on the daemon first. You can still confirm the local pairing.
bd.remoteUiSub: Open and control this BunDeck from any browser (e.g. your phone away from home) through the relay. Every browser needs your approval.
bd.remoteUiAllowHint: Off by default. Whoever runs the relay can see what you do on the page, so only use it if you trust them. You can cut access instantly by turning the switch off or revoking the code.
bd.remoteUiUpdate: Your daemon doesn't support remote UI yet (missing /api/v1/remote/ui-*). Update the daemon to use this section.
bd.remoteUiTunnelDown: No connection to the relay: new codes will show as expired on the phone until the tunnel connects. Check your connection and that the daemon is up to date.
bd.remoteUiOpenHint: Creates a one-time code and its QR to open this BunDeck in your phone's browser.
bd.remoteUiRevokeConfirm: There are {n} pending requests. Revoke the active code?
bd.remoteUiTokenWarn: Save it now: it won't be shown again.
